resources.string: Temporarily pause remapping without turning off the system service
Faster values feel snappier; higher values make double/triple clicks easier.
Recommended for CheerPlay and remotes that emit key events on release
Leaves your phone\'s physical side volume buttons untouched
Press a button on your Bluetooth remote to see live remapped output…
Enable the Relay Service above to start intercepting remote buttons.

Intercepts hardware volume button presses from your paired Bluetooth media remotes and converts single, double, or triple presses into Play/Pause, Next Track, or Previous Track commands. Does not read screen content or collect any data.

Media Button Relay uses Android's Accessibility Service solely to detect hardware volume button presses from connected Bluetooth remotes and translate them into media playback actions (such as Play/Pause or Next Track).

• Cannot read screen text, passwords, or notifications.
• Does not perform automatic taps or UI actions.
• Works 100%% offline — zero data is collected, stored externally, or shared.

You will be taken to Android Accessibility Settings, where you can enable or disable "Media Button Relay" at any time.
